active: Building's coming down on schedule. Be out before it does.
Hard hats on. Fly fast, fly smart.
I call the collapse. You listen.
injured: Still the foreman. Still calling it. Move.
Leg's busted. Building doesn't care. Go.

active.text: Good money, short schedule. My kind of job.
Sign on. I need a pilot who listens.
Fly it right and nobody gets hurt. Take it.

injured.text: Running the crew from a cast. I want you on this.
Leg's busted. I still need a pilot. You.
I'll be on site. Slower. Fly it clean.

active: Through the gap. Good.
That's a clean entry.
On line. Keep it.
injured: Good gap. Keep it that tight.

active: Watch the cornice! I'm under it!
Off my site, now!
Back up, I'm right below you!
injured: Not again. Not on me again!
I can't run on this leg. Back off!

active: Ugh! Block came down on me!
I'm hit. Keep the job moving.
Somebody get this off my leg.
injured: I can't get up. I can't get up.

active: Out before the roof. That's the job.
Clean demo. I'll sign it.
Good. Nobody's under anything.
injured: Done. I'll sign it from the stretcher.
Clean work. Wish I'd been upright for it.

active: Site's shut. We reset tomorrow.
Too slow. The roof doesn't wait.
Walk it back. Think about the line.
injured: Not like this. Not with me hurt.
Pack it up. We try again slower.

active: Safety's the first grade. The rest is pay.
Fair work.
I've seen worse crews.
injured: Grade's fine. Site safety, not so much.

active: Leg's in a cast. Site runs without me for a bit.
I'll be back on the site. Give me time.
Hurt, not done. Remember that.

memorial: Bea, demolition foreman. Called the collapse, every time.

active: Quietest demolition I've ever seen. Nothing fell that shouldn't have.

active.text: You're airborne. Watch the site.
Up. Now mind the scaffolding.
Clean takeoff. Keep it that tidy.

injured.text: You're up. I'm calling it sitting down.

active.text: That was nearly a hole in my wall.
Gap discipline! Now!
Close. The building doesn't move for you.
Low over the site. Hard hats down.
Watch the rubble, you're right on it.
Low and fast. Nice gap.
That's fast. Fast doesn't stop quickly.
Flat out near a site? Bold.
Quick. Now brake early.

injured.text: Slow it down near my people.
Fast. Too fast for me today.

active.text: Battery's low. Finish and get clear.
Low charge. Don't die over the rubble.
Pack's fading. Wrap it.

injured.text: Low battery. Get it out of here.

active.text: Contact! Is it down?
That's a hit. Walk it back.
Structures win. Every time.

injured.text: Ugh. I know how that feels.

active.text: Reset. Start from a safe line.
Back to the start. Plan it this time.
Fresh run. Same rules: get clear.
Weather's moving in. Dust'll get worse.
Wind's changing. Watch the loose sheets.
New weather. Recheck your gaps.
Standing by? So am I.
Holding position. Good. Now move.
You're parked in the air. Clock's running.

injured.text: Holding. Fine. I'm not going anywhere.

active.text: Bea here. No demolition today. Enjoy the buildings standing.
Site's closed, sky's open. Fly smart.
On the radio. Go learn the city.

injured.text: Bea, off shift and mending. Fly careful.

active.text: Right on it. Good line.
There. Clean approach.
That's where I meant. Nice.
